deck_title: MacCormack and BFECC reverse-advection error compensation vs naive Semi-Lagrangian linear diffusion rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Dupont & Liu (2003 BFECC) and Selle et al. (2008 MacCormack) reverse-advection error compensation (phi_corr = phi_fwd + 0.5*(phi_0 - phi_bwd), measuring the symmetric round-trip linear interpolation diffusion 2*e(alpha) and subtracting e(alpha) = 2*alpha*(1-alpha) to lock quadratic peak retention R = 1.0000x across all 17 sub-cell Courant stations alpha in [0, 1]) versus naive single-pass Semi-Lagrangian advection (Stam 1999, which diffuses peak amplitude as 1 - 2*alpha*(1-alpha) down to 0.6250x at alpha=0.25 and 0.5000x at alpha=0.50 across 15/17 interior stations) and 64-mode discrete Fourier spectral shift.
